repo.name: vibe-pi-android
repo.description: F-Droid repository for Pi Agent, a native Android client (written in Odin) for pi-agent-webui.

apps.description:
Pi Agent is a native Android client for the pi-agent-webui server.
It is written entirely in Odin (no Java/Kotlin), renders its own UI
with OpenGL ES and talks to the server's WebSocket RPC endpoint.

Point it at your server (LAN or VPN, ws:// only) to browse sessions,
start new ones, and chat with the Pi coding agent with live streaming,
tool-call cards and model selection.
